  • How can we measure the impact of these interventions on the daily lives of people with disabilities?

The study will involve collaboration with local disability organizations, healthcare providers, and policymakers to ensure the relevance and applicability of the findings.

These recommendations will aim to improve access to resources, enhance social inclusion, and promote independence among people with disabilities.

Conclusion

Improving the quality of life for people with disabilities is not only a moral imperative but also a critical step towards building more inclusive and equitable societies. This research project aims to contribute to this goal by providing actionable insights and strategies that can be implemented at various levels of society.
